processes.title: Tech Debt & Modernisation
processes.summary: Make technical debt visible, rank it with features, and pay it down in flow or through planned modernisation.

definition.purpose: Keep the product healthy and changeable by making debt visible, priced and paid.
definition.outcome: A ranked tech-debt register (TDR-###), paydown in flow, modernisation plans (MOD-##) for larger work, and fitness functions proving debt is paid.
definition.jtbd: Help me show what our shortcuts and ageing parts cost, and fix the ones that matter before they hurt.

exit: Top items planned or accepted with revisit dates
Paid items verified by fitness functions

cases.happyPath: Debt recorded as found, ranked quarterly, paid in a fixed capacity share.
alternates: Large debt → modernisation plan to the portfolio review
edgeCases: Zero interest but a hard end-of-life date
Debt in a vendor component
failures: Debt invisible until it causes incidents

routing.forward: Paydown items → PLAN; modernisation plan and paydown report → 8.4 Portfolio Review

routing.stop: Accept the debt with a revisit date — recorded in the learning log

rules: No big-bang rewrite without portfolio approval
policies: Capacity allocation for debt agreed quarterly

agents: AI coding agents for scanning and impact analysis
